overview_description.description: CyCognito is a revolutionary new approach to external cyber risk management driven to create positive business impact. Far deeper than external attack surface management, our platform helps organizations identify, understand and master their risk in profound new ways. Fully-automated, highly scalable, and designed to function as promised, our platform uses advanced machine learning and natural language processing to allow for unprecedented reach, speed and accuracy. We can step into the shoes of potential attackers—which in turn helps us identify and secure gaps better than anyone. We help teams secure their attack surface by helping them determine true risks, where they need to focus and how they should invest. And then we use what we learn to help bridge cyber risk remediation across departments unlike ever before.

about_short_description.short_description: CyCognito is a leading exposure management platform that is fully-automated & highly scalable, driven to create positive business impact

product.name: External Attack Surface Management (EASM)
product.description: A platform that continuously discovers, tests, and prioritizes risks across an organization's external attack surface.

product.name: Automated Security Testing (AutoPT)
product.description: Automated testing that validates network infrastructure and web applications continuously to identify security gaps.

product.name: Cyber Asset Inventory (CAASM)
product.description: A solution to identify and inventory unmanaged cyber assets that are invisible to traditional asset management systems.

product.name: Unified Vulnerability Management (UVM)
product.description: A platform that prioritizes vulnerabilities based on actual risks present in the external attack surface.

product.name: Cloud Security Posture Management (CNAPP)
product.description: A solution that identifies and tests all exposed cloud assets to reveal security gaps missed by other CNAPP tools.

product.name: Application Security (AppSec)
product.description: A platform to discover web applications and APIs, perform continuous dynamic application security testing (DAST), and ensure web application firewall (WAF) coverage.
